discovery.title: Read-only storage inspection
discovery.note: Uses PegaProx-managed connections and inspects existing state only. It never logs in, mounts, formats or registers storage.
discovery.phase.nfs_exports: Scanning NFS exports from selected PVE nodes
discovery.limit.read_only: Inspection is read-only and is not authorization for future changes.
discovery.limit.nfs_no_mount: The NFS export is not mounted during inspection.
discovery.limit.nfs_no_write_test: No write/read test is performed on the NFS export.
discovery.limit.iscsi_no_discovery: No iSCSI SendTargets discovery is started.
discovery.limit.iscsi_no_login: No iSCSI target login or session change is performed.
discovery.limit.iscsi_no_mount: No block device or filesystem is mounted.
discovery.limit.iscsi_no_format: No signature is removed and no filesystem is created.
discovery.limit.iscsi_no_registration: No PBS datastore is created or modified.
